paragraphs.text: Lady Evangela was a legendary human cleric who lived in ancient times on Dominaria , before the Brothers' War .
Since her youth, Evangela was fascinated by rainbows; the sight of them would fill her with peace, which she shared with others.

Lady Evangela is most often associated with the true moon of Dominaria: a mosaic from the College of Lat-Nam depicts her riding a rainbow to the Mist Moon . Evangela's name was invoked in the idioms "Lady Evangela give me strength" and "for the love of Lady Evangela" across Dominaria over four thousand years after her death.
